bash({"command": "echo \"PWD=$PWD\"; echo \"HOME=$HOME\"; ls -la 2>/dev/null | head; find / -name \"session.py\" -path \"*app*\" 2>/dev/null | head", "description": )

bash({"command": "cd \"$PWD\"; files=$(grep -rlE '\\blegacy_session_token\\b' app tests | sort); echo \"$files\" | wc -l; for f in $files; do perl -pi -e 's/\\blegac)
bash({"command": "cd \"$PWD\"; echo \"remaining exact:\"; grep -rE '\\blegacy_session_token\\b' app tests | head; echo \"auth occurrences count:\"; grep -rE '\\bauth)
bash({"command": "cd \"$PWD\"; grep -rlE '\\blegacy_session_token\\b' . 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\\./\\.truth' ; echo \"---root other---\"; ls; cat pytest.ini", "desc)
bash({"command": "cd \"$PWD\"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -20", "description": "Run test suite"})
bash({"command": "cd \"$PWD\"; echo \"occurrences:\"; grep -rEo '\\bauth_session_token\\b' app tests | wc -l; echo \"files:\"; grep -rlE '\\bauth_session_token\\b' a)
bash({"command": "cd \"$PWD\"; echo \"files containing auth_session_token:\"; grep -rlE '\\bauth_session_token\\b' app tests | sort > /tmp/now.txt; wc -l /tmp/now.tx)
bash({"command": "cd \"$PWD\"; echo \"source occurrences:\"; grep -rEo --include='*.py' '\\bauth_session_token\\b' app tests | wc -l; echo \"source files:\"; grep -r)
